verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents `fhcli`, a command-line tool for submitting changes from existing CI or orchestration systems such as Jenkins deploys, Docker image builds and CI build statuses (docs-70, docs-83). Its API claims parity with "anything you can do on the FireHydrant UI" (docs-21), authenticated with token-based API keys and bot tokens suited to non-human automation (docs-48, docs-66, docs-81). missing for 10: documented CLI scope beyond recording change events, concrete CI pipeline examples or setup guides, independent or hands-on corroboration of headless use.
